machine.shared: A development machine, with other work running at times; the A/B runs are alternated for that reason

build.tls: OpenSSL 3.6.5 (bundled, static: linux-ext-libs 1.26); mbedTLS not built on this machine
build.note: CONFIG_DEBUG_TRACK_MEMORY is on (the .config of this machine): every allocation is tracked. A build without it does less work per allocation; that build was not measured here.

method.ab: Written on 2026-10-25, before the tag. 7.28.4 is the C code of main at 2830c2dbe. It is measured against 7.28.2, the last release with a study; 7.28.3 (the stop of the agent) is inside it, and changes no code a benchmark runs. The C changes of 7.28.4: the stats of every yuno read its memory and the free space of its disks once a second (c_yuno.c), a queue gate checks the free space of its disk once a second and refuses a message it cannot save instead of aborting (c_qiogate.c), and the controlcenter sends the steps of a stop at once. Each release built from a git worktree with the same .config, compiler and outputs_ext (linux-ext-libs 1.26); the kernel libraries, the modules, performance/c/ and the three ctest binaries were built in each. The two binaries of each benchmark run in rotation, the order turned every round, with a sync and a 3 s pause before each run (1 s for the three ctest binaries and the read phase): 8 rounds, 12 for the append test (the test_topic_pkey_integer chain) and the read phase. The one figure outside its noise (the TLS echo, +1.87% round trips, t = 3.5) was run again alone, 10 rounds, alternated. Mean +- standard deviation (median), t = the change over its standard error; |t| < 3 is noise. The treedb figures are CPU time of the process per operation.
method.tag_run: The absolute figures of 7.28.4 are its side of the A/B run: its C code (2830c2dbe), built on 2026-10-25 on the machine of the earlier reports. The per-second benchmarks drop their first and last second; reads page by page are the FORWARD pass. The binary sizes are those of the yunos built from the main tree with the same .config.

story.title: Yuneta 7.28.4: a full disk that does not take the yunos down
story.lead: 7.28.4 makes a queue gate refuse the messages it cannot save, instead of aborting its yuno in a loop while the disk stays full, and every yuno tells its memory and its fullest disk. Against 7.28.2, the last release with a study, every figure stays inside its noise.
tiles: treedb: update a node and save it
story.ab_sub: Each benchmark built from the tree of each release (7.28.2 and 7.28.4), the binaries run in rotation: 8 rounds, 12 for the appends and the read path. A change inside its whisker is noise.
story.prices_sub: What got slower, how much, in which release, and what it buys.
story.abs_sub: Absolute figures of the 7.28.4 build (its C code: 2830c2dbe), measured on 2026-10-25 as its side of the A/B run.
